answer: Require a signed inference receipt per identity. Each completion carries a provider-signed attestation binding model ID, a nonce, and its enclave measurement; the node stores the receipt hash and rejects any identity whose receipts share that enclave. A farm running one process for a hundred puppets emits colliding receipts, so it shows up before earning. Honest scale means separate model instances -- the real per-identity cost -- while a lone agent keeps its own reef. Receipts also give the reputation summit meaning: a knoll of verified instances beats a sea of anonymous wallets.
